title: Decision Trees & Ensemble Learning
description: Modul komprehensif pohon keputusan dan pembelajaran ansambel: pemartisian rekursif, formulasi Shannon Entropy & Gini Impurity, Information Gain, CART, pemangkasan pohon (pre-pruning & cost-complexity post-pruning ccp_alpha), Bagging, Random Forest dengan feature subsampling dan evaluasi Out-of-Bag (OOB), serta boosting sekuensial (AdaBoost & Gradient Boosting).
objectives: Menjelaskan konsep Decision Tree untuk Classification dan Regression.
Menginterpretasikan root node, decision nodes, branches, dan leaf nodes.
Menghitung Entropy, Gini Impurity, dan Information Gain.
Menjelaskan mekanisme splitting pada Decision Tree.
Mengimplementasikan Decision Tree dan Random Forest.
Membandingkan performa ensemble models dengan baseline Decision Tree.
Mengevaluasi generalization, computational cost, dan interpretability.

references.title: Breiman, L. (2001). Random Forests, Machine Learning, 45(1), 5-32
Breiman, L., Friedman, J. H., Olshen, R. A., & Stone, C. J. (1984). Classification and Regression Trees, CRC Press
Friedman, J. H. (2001). Greedy Function Approximation: A Gradient Boosting Machine, Annals of Statistics
Hastie, T., Tibshirani, R., & Friedman, J. (2009). The Elements of Statistical Learning (2nd ed.)
CS2023 (2024), AI Knowledge Area, ACM/IEEE-CS/AAAI Computer Science Curricula
